items.title_en: Danish Sait Aka Mr Nags of RCB Has Already Won an IPL Trophy, Here's Proof
items.title_zh: RCB 的丹麦人 Sait Aka Mr Nags 已经赢得了 IPL 奖杯，这是证据
items.summary_en: Danish Sait, who is also known as Mr. Nags, recently tweeted a photo of himself sitting with an IPL trophy, proving that he has already won one, unlike the other RCB stars.
items.summary_zh: 丹麦赛特（Danish Sait），也被称为纳格斯先生，最近在推特上发布了一张自己坐在 IPL 奖杯上的照片，证明他已经赢得了冠军，这与其他 RCB 明星不同。
